scope: Synthetic printed text and table cell OCR; no table-structure extraction or real-scan accuracy claim

policy.required: Full text and every required cell exact after NFC and whitespace normalization; exact reading order; valid word geometry; no unassigned words
policy.stress: Same measurements, diagnostic only; never silently lowers required accuracy thresholds
policy.cellAssignment: Center of each word quadrilateral in the authored cell polygon; preserve detected line/word order
